results.name: Skincare Product Shelf
results.description: A shoppable skincare wall that turns into a full product page. Twelve photoreal cosmetics, drawn entirely in SVG with glossy reflections, ridged caps and see-through glass, sit on floating shelves. Click one and it glides off the shelf, turns as its label wraps around the bottle,
results.author: aakashmehra

results.name: Foggy Window Wipe
results.description:
For Foggy Window Wipe:

Description

A photo behind a fogged, wet window that you wipe clean with your cursor. Click and drag to clear the glass, scroll to change the wipe size. Every stroke leaves soft streaks and beads of water along its edges, drops gather and run down through
results.author: aakashmehra

results.name: Sports Car Dashboard Menu
results.description: A night-time driver's seat view as a navigation menu: press and hold the ignition key to crank and start the engine, watch the needles sweep and the cluster light up, rev it, honk the horn, and use the steering wheel buttons as page links. Some starts fail with a flat battery or a flooded backfire. Synthesized engine sound.
results.author: aakashmehra

results.name: Liquid Glass Login
results.description: A sign-in card made of real refracting liquid glass over slow, layered flames and rising embers. The card, fields and buttons bend and colour-fringe what is behind them, and the whole form can be dragged anywhere. Email, password, forgot password, and Google, Apple and GitHub sign-in.
results.author: aakashmehra

results.name: Interactive Sniper Scope
results.description: A full-screen rifle scope with a lit green mil-dot reticle, breathing sway and recoil. Shoot glass bottles on a wooden range shelf and they shatter into real fractured shards that bounce and settle. Hit the HOME plate to go home, or RESET to restock. All canvas, synthesized sound.
results.author: aakashmehra

results.name: Retro Slide to Unlock
results.description: A skeuomorphic lock screen inspired by early-2010s phones: live clock, drawn water wallpaper, a shimmering slide to unlock knob, camera peek, and working home and sleep buttons with music controls, in an optional classic phone frame. Fully props-driven and keyboard accessible.
results.author: aakashmehra

results.name: Nearby Walk Menu
results.description: A line-drawn walking scene from a hotel to nearby landmarks and N Seoul Tower: landmarks rise in, walkers follow the route, hover swaps walking time for distance, with four full-page themes and a lantern cursor glow.
results.author: aakashmehra

results.name: Coffee Pour Menu
results.description: A coffee menu with detailed SVG cups and hand-written physics: hover a drink and its cup slides in, coffee and milk pour, splash and blend, and the previous cup tips over and falls away.
results.author: aakashmehra

results.name: Holographic Business Card
results.description: An interactive business card that tilts toward your pointer, lifts on hover and flips on click, with nine holographic foils (Shards, Rainbow, Stars, Cosmos, Hearts, Shapes, Gold, Silver, Aurora) set by the effect and intensity props.
results.author: aakashmehra

results.name: Liquid Glass Button
results.description: A draggable liquid glass Home pill: a Snell's-law displacement map bends the light behind it, with chromatic fringes at the rim. Safari and Firefox get a frosted glassmorphism fallback.
results.author: aakashmehra

results.name: Disc Reveal List
results.description: A hover-reveal list: titles scatter their letters, the other rows dim, and spinning colour-rimmed CDs or polaroids spring in around the active row.
results.author: aakashmehra
